scope: S3 completion on original Research C Development and Held-out cohorts only

data_generation.restoration: deterministic reconstruction of original observations with exact stored digest assertion

ex_post_benchmarks.single_edit: minimum realized regret over no-edit and all initially feasible M4 single edits
ex_post_benchmarks.two_edit: minimum realized regret over no-edit, all feasible one-edit and all ordered feasible two-edit paths; intermediate candidate re-evaluation; DAG checked after every edit
ex_post_benchmarks.interaction: V(e1,e2)-V(e1)-V(e2), only when both edits and sequence are feasible from G0

execution_source_revision: The commit containing this lock and run_s3_completion.py; recorded in the resulting summary after commit, before execution
